note: Campaign A/B tests beta (PR #406). Adds variants, variantStrategy, experimentOutcome and analytics experiment results to Messaging and Platform campaigns; the full snapshots stay pinned to contracts/source.json until the next repin.

key.description: Identifier of the variant, unique in the campaign: a lowercase letter, then up to 15 lowercase letters, digits, `_` or `-`.

label.description: Name shown in results, 1 to 100 characters.

weight.description: Share of the test group that receives this variant, in percent. The weights of all variants add up to 100.

source.description: The message text, 1 to 4,096 characters. `{{variable}}` placeholders are filled per recipient, as in composed messages.

CampaignVariantMessage.description: The message this variant sends, in the composed-message format.

winnerCriterion.description: The outcome that decides the winner: the share of sent test messages that were delivered, read or replied to by the test deadline.

holdoutPercent.description: Percent of recipients, 0 to 30, who receive no message. They are marked `skipped` with `lastError` `experiment_holdout` at launch.

testSlicePercent.description: Percent of recipients, 5 to 50, who receive a variant during the test. Defaults to 20. The rest, the reserve, wait for the winner.

autoPromote.description: Must be `true`: after the test window the winner is sent to the reserve automatically.

testWindowMinutes.description: Minutes from the start of sending until the test is decided, 15 to 1,440.

winnerKey.description: The winning variant's `key`; only when `state` is `promoted`.

CampaignExperimentOutcome.description: The saved A/B result. `promoted` names the variant sent to the reserve. `inconclusive` means the test paused the campaign with the reserve unsent; the campaign cannot resume, so stop it or duplicate it.

holdoutCount.description: Recipients held out; they receive no message.

reserveCount.description: Recipients who wait for the winner.

outcomeRate.description: The `criterion` count divided by `sent`, counting every result received so far.

CampaignExperimentResults.description: A/B results by variant; null for a broadcast. The decision counts only results received by the test deadline, so `outcomeRate` can differ from the rate the decision used.

Campaign.variants.description: The A/B variants; null for a broadcast.

CreateCampaignRequest.variants.description: Two to four messages to test. Requires `variantStrategy` and cannot be combined with `templateId`. A/B tests are a beta; a team that is not enrolled gets `403 feature_unavailable`. Omit, or send null with a null `variantStrategy`, for a broadcast.

UpdateCampaignRequest.variants.description: Replaces the A/B variants. Null, together with a null `variantStrategy`, makes the draft a broadcast. Only an unlaunched draft can change it.
